title: Jam Shared Data Manifest
description: Unified bootstrap entry for shared data. bootstrap is eagerly loaded to resolve world/template selection, while content is name-indexed and intended for archetype-scoped loading after world assembly decisions are known.

bootstrap_entry.description: Global bootstrap document path. These entries are read eagerly during client/server shared-data initialization.

path.description: Relative path to a bootstrap shared-data json document.

content_entry.description: Named content document entry. The enclosing property name is the canonical shared-data lookup name.

path.description: Relative path to a named shared-data json document.

bootstrap_root.description: Global bootstrap inputs that are loaded before world selection and before any per-archetype content resolution.

world_instances.description: Canonical logical world instance root document.

actor_archetypes.description: Canonical global actor archetype root document.

content_root.description: Named content documents resolved after a world archetype has been selected. These entries are intended for archetype-scoped loading and caching.
